name: Three-Act Structure
source: Classical dramatic structure (Aristotle via Syd Field)
license_note: Public-domain structural vocabulary; prompts are original prose.

beats.name: Inciting Incident
beats.prompt: What disturbance sets the story question?

beats.name: First Act Break
beats.prompt: What irreversible commitment ends the beginning?

beats.name: Midpoint
beats.prompt: What reversal re-frames the goal at the centre?

beats.name: Second Act Break (Crisis)
beats.prompt: What lowest point forces the final approach?

beats.name: Climax
beats.prompt: Where is the story question answered decisively?
